title: Speaking Coach items (DRAFT, not released)
description: A DRAFT for the next contracts version after main's, not part of any release: the three Speaking Coach item types of the prototype (ADR-0044 §6), speak_repeat (listen and repeat), speak_respond (a guided short answer) and roleplay (a role-play card for the AI patient). The released validator never loads this file. When the owner accepts the Speaking Coach, these types move into schemas/release-package.schema.json as a minor version, with RP-SPEAK-* rules (see README.md). All content is original: never official OET material.

draft_of.description: The contracts version this draft would become (the next minor after main's when the PR was opened).

itemId.description: oa-speak- and six digits. 990000-999999 are fixtures.

profession.description: A profession key of the taxonomy (nursing, medicine, …), or null for every profession.

audioFile.description: A recording in the package, checked as the lab's audio is (hash, bytes, duration).

voice.description: <accent>-<f|m>-<name>, as the lab's voices. Model sentences are British English (en-GB).

focus.description: What the sentence practises, for the card.

shown.description: The sentence as the learner reads it (digits and units allowed).

spoken.description: The sentence as it is said, in words: the pronunciation engine's reference text.

chunks.description: The sense groups of `spoken`, in order, for the retry ladder (word, then chunk, then sentence). Joined with spaces they are `spoken` without its final punctuation (RP-SPEAK-CHUNKS).

target_sounds.description: Optional: the IPA phonemes the sentence is written to practise (for the progress record and the study planner).

slow.description: The same voice at about 0.75 of the normal speed, every sound kept.

pass_score.description: At or above this overall score (0-100) the feedback says the sentence is clear. It never blocks the learner.

prompt.description: The situation and the task, as the learner reads it.

patient_line.description: The patient's question, spoken by the page.

patient_voice.description: Optional: the text-to-speech voice for the patient's line, <accent>-<f|m>-<name>.

key_points.description: What a good answer covers: the marker's checklist, shown after the answer.

model_answer.description: Optional: one good answer, shown after marking.

profession.description: A role-play is for one profession.

patient.description: The AI patient's card. Server-side only: never sent to the learner's browser before the report (x-oa-visibility assessor once in the release schema).

emotion.description: How the patient feels at the start.

hidden.description: Facts the patient gives only when asked about them.

concern.description: The worry the learner should find and address; the report says whether it came up.

prepare_s.description: OET Speaking: three minutes to prepare.

talk_s.description: OET Speaking: about five minutes to talk.
